title: Tanzanian-Flagged Tanker Hijacked by Somali Pirates Off Yemen Coast
summary: A Tanzanian-flagged tanker, the MT Asana, was allegedly hijacked by seven armed Somali pirates off the coast of Yemen. The vessel was reportedly taken to the Puntland region of Somalia after the incident. A distress alert was also sent from the ship during the hijacking.
summary_points: A Tanzanian-flagged tanker was hijacked by Somali pirates off the coast of Yemen.
The MT Asana was allegedly taken to the Puntland region of Somalia after the hijacking.
A distress alert was sent from the ship during the incident.
The hijacking is believed to have occurred in international waters.
The incident highlights the ongoing threat of piracy in the Gulf of Aden and the Indian Ocean.

summary_hi: तंजानिया के झंडे वाले तेल टैंकर एमटी असाना को कथित तौर पर सात हथियारबंद सोमाली समुद्री लुटेरों ने अपहरण कर लिया. घटना के बाद जहाज को सोमालिया के पुंटलैंड क्षेत्र के कालूला तट के पास ले जाया गया है. रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक, अपहरण के दौरान टैंकर से डिस्ट्रेस अलर्ट भी भेजा गया थ.
